acceptedClaims.statement: For the governed half-skew BSSC product channel P^{otimes 2}, let M be the unnormalized finite-auxiliary Marton sum value of any law (W,U,V)-X_1X_2-(Y^2,Z^2), let q_i=Pr[X_i=1], Q=q_1+q_2, let C_out=I(Y_1;Y_2)+I(Z_1;Z_2), and let c_in=P(X_1X_2=11)-q_1q_2. Canonical transaction 33a5944dca980bf94cc869c6c7dee2d04385ff58 supplies the two pre-averaging Marton-to-input rows and their universal average M <= G(P_{X_1X_2})+2r, while canonical transaction 88a1004f309460f3ec1cacdae88d30f88559f9bc supplies the exact directed threshold T=2L_RTD. The exact identity G=F(q_1)+F(q_2)-C_out/2 and the coordinatewise concave row envelopes imply that M>T forces q_1,q_2 in (3/8,5/8), hence in (7/20,13/20), together with 17/20<Q<23/20, C_out<7/160=0.04375<0.044 bits, and |c_in|<7/40. On the reflected/transposed family P(00)=P(11)=alpha and P(01)=P(10)=1/2-alpha, a gain additionally forces 1/8<alpha<5/13. These are necessary conditions only; they do not establish a two-letter gain, rule one out, or give a capacity converse.
